flagged.title: Détente, SALT 1 and the Nixon-Brezhnev Era
flagged.reason: F77 is mark-affecting because the video teaches an incorrect cause and sequence, claiming Nixon's China trip prompted Brezhnev to agree to the Moscow summit within three months, whereas the summit had already been agreed in October 1971.

mark_affecting.quote: So within just three months of Nixon's China trip, Brezhnev agreed to host Nixon in Moscow.
